A321.approach_speed_note: The final approach speed is 140 knot at a MALW of 166,449 lb and classifies the aircraft into the AAC C while approach speed is 142 knot at a MALW of 171,520 lb and classifies into the AAC D. AAC validated by Flight Standardization Board (FSB) report. Flap reading: the dual value is by landing weight, not flap setting: 140 kt at MALW 166,449 lb (AAC C), 142 kt at MALW 171,520 lb (AAC D). Stated approximation: both values are scaled from the single malw_kg (77,800 kg); the 140 kt lower edge, quoted at 75,500 kg, is therefore ~1.5 % low at any mass (permissive).
